title: Learning From Static Context in Federated Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2611.06064v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Time series forecasting is shifting from locally trained, per-series models to global models trained across many heterogeneous series, which requires learning what sets the series apart. When the raw data cannot be centralized, such a global model is trained with federated learning (FL), one client per data owner. State-of-the-art forecasters such as the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) tell series apart through a static input that describes each series and does not change over time. In the special case of a federated setting where each client holds a single series, this static input is constant within each client and varies only across clients. We ask whether a federated TFT can learn from it. Per-batch FedAdam, which aggregates gradients after every batch, uses the static input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing

translated_title: 联邦时间序列预测中从静态上下文学习
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测正在从针对单个序列本地训练的模型，转向跨众多异构序列训练的全局模型，这要求模型学习区分不同序列的特征。当原始数据无法集中时，这种全局模型需要通过联邦学习（FL）进行训练，每个数据拥有者对应一个客户端。最先进的预测模型（如时间融合Transformer，TFT）通过一个描述每个序列且不随时间变化的静态输入来区分不同序列。在每个客户端仅持有一个序列的联邦设置这一特殊情况下，该静态输入在每个客户端内部是恒定的，仅在客户端之间存在差异。我们探究了联邦化的TFT能否从中进行学习。研究发现：逐批次聚合梯度的Per-batch FedAdam几乎能像集中式训练一样充分利用静态输入，而采用本地epoch的通信高效方案（FedAvg、FedAdam+Prox）则从中提取的信息少得多，且无法从中获益。
tldr: 在联邦时间序列预测中，逐批次聚合梯度的FedAdam几乎能像集中式训练一样充分利用描述序列的静态上下文输入，而采用本地epoch的通信高效方案（如FedAvg、FedAdam+Prox）则难以从中学习且无法获益。
en_tdlr: In federated time series forecasting, per-batch FedAdam exploits static per-series context input almost as well as central training, whereas communication-efficient schemes with local epochs (FedAvg, FedAdam+Prox) extract far less from it and gain nothing.
